_comment: Immutable pin of the IHP model files the benches load. Verified by sim/tools/verify_pdk.py BEFORE any simulator runs. Only the file hashes establish a match; install_marker is provenance.

install_marker.note: Provenance only: a marker never establishes a match, and a missing marker is reported as unknown (hashes decide).

closure_note: Dependency closure of cornerHBT.lib (.include/.lib file targets, followed transitively). HBT-only: sim/smoke-hbt/ instantiates npn13G2 (native VBIC, no OSDI). The MOS/PSP OSDI closure (cornerMOSlv.lib / cornerMOShv.lib, PSP OSDI files) is deliberately NOT listed: it is only needed if the LO buffer/bias uses MOS devices, which is undecided. Extend this list when a MOS bench lands. Hashes re-derived 2026-10-17 from the local v0.3.0 install; they equal the sibling pins in sg13g2-sat-rx sim/pdk-artifact.json.
